design_principles: Emotion First: The UI must feel fresh, tactile, and trustworthy.
Mobile-First App Layout: Thumb-zone optimized, bento grid for promos, bottom sticky nav.
Contrast & Texture: Use organic colors over clinical whites. 1px borders with soft shadows.
Negative Space: Generous padding around produce imagery to highlight freshness.

color_system.description: Warm, earthy base with high-contrast forest greens and energetic terracotta accents.

rules: Headings must use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for a modern retail feel.
DO NOT use generic sans (Inter/Roboto) for headings.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, and wide spaced (tracking-widest).

layout_and_spacing.container: If web-based, use max-w-md mx-auto relative overflow-hidden h-screen to mimic mobile. If React Native, use SafeAreaView with flex-1.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Home screen banners should use a 2-column bento grid (e.g. 1 large span-2, 2 small span-1).
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-4 to p-6 for screen edges. Gap-4 for product grids.

bottom_navigation.style: Fixed bottom, z-50, solid white or glassmorphism (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md), top border (border-t border-border).
bottom_navigation.interaction: Active state uses primary color (Forest Green). Inactive is text-secondary.

product_card.image: aspect-square or h-32 w-full object-cover, soft gray background.
product_card.content: p-3, left-aligned title (font-medium text-sm), price (text-base font-bold text-primary).
product_card.action: Add to cart button should be right-aligned pill or circular button (+ icon) in primary or accent color.

search_bar.style: Rounded-full, bg-muted, border-none, h-12 px-4, left-aligned search icon.

checkout_flow.style: Bottom sheets for cart summary. Large, sticky primary button at the bottom for 'Place Order'.

icons_and_assets.style: Stroke width 1.5 or 2, consistent sizing (w-6 h-6 for nav).

image_urls.description: Top-down view of fresh organic vegetables
Minimalist composition of milk, eggs, bread
Colorful assortment of fresh tropical fruits

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Add 'data-testid' to EVERY interactive element (buttons, nav links, cart items, checkout form).
If using React/Tailwind to mimic mobile, wrap the main layout in <div className='max-w-md mx-auto h-screen bg-background relative overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden shadow-2xl'>.
Ensure the bottom navigation is fixed at the bottom of the container, NOT the absolute window if restricted to max-w-md.
Implement a Bento Grid for the Home Screen hero section using CSS Grid (grid-cols-2).
Use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and Manrope for body text. Load via Google Fonts or Fontsource.
NEVER use dummy placeholder images. Use the URLs provided in this JSON.
Use Lucide-React for all icons. Stroke-width 1.5.
Use Shadcn/UI primitives but heavily strip their Vercel-look borders/shadows to match the 'Organic & Earthy' theme (use rounded-2xl, soft bg colors).
